title: A coverage report document
description: One evidence package's coverage report (SEG-SREQ-035): the package gate's CoverageReport, serialized. Single-authored — the generator adds nothing beyond what the gate itself found: the eight typed findings, the diagnostics each one becomes, and whether the scope is blocked.

state.description: Every non-active state (SEG-SREQ-043); active edges never appear on the worklist.

coverageGaps.description: Requirement identifiers whose own direct coverage fails (SEG-SREQ-044).

staleOutcomes.description: Outcome identifiers whose recorded revision differed from the package's current revision (SEG-SREQ-063, SEG-SREQ-067).

discardedOutcomes.description: Outcome identifiers discarded as incomplete evidence.

unwaivedOutcomes.description: Failing outcome identifiers, that is failed or error, with no valid excusing waiver (SEG-SREQ-060).

excusedOutcomes.description: Failing outcome identifiers, that is failed or error, validly excused by a waiver (SEG-SREQ-061).

skippedOutcomes.description: Outcome identifiers whose result is skipped (SEG-SREQ-199). A skipped outcome is absence of evidence: it never blocks, and no waiver excuses it. The writer always emits this array. A package sealed before the field existed carries none, and a reader treats an absent array as not judged for skips, which differs from an empty array.

designSetEmpty.description: Whether the scope held no Requirement node at all (SEG-SREQ-045).

condition.description: One member of the gate's closed condition vocabulary (SEG-SREQ-064).

detail.description: Occurrence-specific detail, kept apart from condition (SEG-SREQ-065); empty when a finding has none to give.

blocked.description: Whether any diagnostic here has a severity that blocks generating a package (SEG-SREQ-042).
